en.tagline: Generate and edit images with 50+ AI models via belt CLI
en.summary: This skill runs AI image models from the command line through the belt CLI and inference.sh. It covers text-to-image, image editing, inpainting, LoRA styles, upscaling and text rendering. It gives you one way to call many image models, such as GPT-Image-2.6, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream and Reve.
problem: Image models differ in their inputs, options and strengths. Trying each one through its own interface takes time and makes comparison hard.
With this skill, you pick a model by its app ID and send a JSON input with a prompt. The same belt command pattern works for every model in the list.
fit: Making product mockups or marketing visuals from a text prompt
Editing an existing image, such as changing the background
Comparing several image models with the same prompt
Upscaling an image or stitching several images together
unfit: Video generation or AI avatars, which have their own skills
Projects that cannot use the belt CLI or log in to inference.sh
steps: Choose a model by its app ID, for example `openai/gpt-image-2-6-flare` or `falai/flux-dev-lora`.
Write a JSON input that includes a `prompt`, and add image URLs for editing or upscaling.
Run the image with `belt app run <app-id> --input '<json>'`.
Use `belt app list --category image` to see other image apps.

zh.tagline: 通过 belt CLI 调用50多种AI模型生成和编辑图片
zh.summary: 这个技能通过 belt CLI 和 inference.sh 在命令行中调用 AI 图片模型。它支持文生图、图片编辑、局部重绘、LoRA 风格、放大和文字渲染。你可以用同一种方式调用 GPT-Image-2.6、FLUX、Gemini、Grok、Seedream、Reve 等多个模型。
problem: 不同图片模型的输入参数、可选项和擅长方向各不相同。如果逐个使用各自的界面，既费时间，也难以比较效果。
使用这个技能后，你只需用应用 ID 选择模型，并传入包含提示词的 JSON 输入。列表中所有模型都使用相同的 belt 命令格式。
fit: 根据文字提示制作产品效果图或营销配图
编辑已有图片，例如更换背景
用同一提示词比较多个图片模型的效果
放大图片，或把多张图片拼接在一起
unfit: 视频生成或 AI 数字人，这些有各自的技能
无法使用 belt CLI 或无法登录 inference.sh 的项目
steps: 用应用 ID 选择模型，例如 `openai/gpt-image-2-6-flare` 或 `falai/flux-dev-lora`。
编写 JSON 输入，包含 `prompt`；如需编辑或放大，再加上图片 URL。
用 `belt app run <app-id> --input '<json>'` 运行生成。
用 `belt app list --category image` 查看其他图片应用。
